author: smcarus
title: Will India's economy grow faster in 2026 than in 2025?
summary: Give the probability that IMF WEO real GDP growth for India is higher for 2026 than for 2025, both as first read on or after 1 May 2027 (after the April 2027 WEO).
knownLimits: The 2026 figure in the April 2027 WEO is still an IMF estimate and may be revised later; the first reading stands.
The IMF reports India on a fiscal-year basis (April to March); the WEO figure as published is used.
